steps.title: Prepare Sample Tube
steps.instruction: Insert the filter into a 5 ml PowerWater DNA Bead Tube.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Bead Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of Solution PW1 to the PowerWater DNA Bead tube and vortex vigorously.

substeps.instruction: Secure the tube horizontally to a Vortex and tape it extensively
Vortex at maximum speed for 5 min
Centrifuge the tubes ≤4000 x g for 1 min at room temperature

steps.title: First Supernatant Recovery
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.

substeps.instruction: Draw up the supernatant using a 1 ml pipette tip by placing it down into the beads

steps.title: Clarification Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collection tube at 13,000 x g for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second Supernatant Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 ml Collection Tube (provided), avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: IRS Treatment and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl of Solution IRS to the supernatant and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Vortex briefly to mix
Incubate at 2–8°C for 5 min

steps.title: Post-IRS Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 13,000 x g for 1 min.

steps.title: Third Supernatant Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean 2 ml Collection Tube (provided), avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: PW3 Mixing
steps.instruction: Add 650 µl of Solution PW3 and vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: MB Spin Column Loading
steps.instruction: Process the supernatant through an MB Spin Column.

substeps.instruction: Load 650 µl of supernatant onto an MB Spin Column
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min
Discard the flow-through
Repeat until all the supernatant has been processed

steps.title: Column Preparation for Washing
steps.instruction: Place the MB Spin Column Filter into a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.

steps.title: PW4 Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with Solution PW4.

substeps.instruction: Shake Solution PW4 before use
Add 650 µl of Solution PW4
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min
Discard the flow-through
Add 650 µl of ethanol
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min

steps.title: Dry Column
steps.instruction: Dry the column membrane by centrifuging.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flow-through
Centrifuge again at 13,000 x g for 2 min

steps.title: Prepare for Elution
steps.instruction: Place the MB Spin Column into a clean 2 ml Collection Tube.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the filter membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl of Solution EB to the center of the white filter membrane
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min
